title: Ice Optimized
description: A super simple FPS optimization modpack that makes the gaming experience smoother and more enjoyable.
body:
# ❄️ IceOptimizer — Break the Ice, Boost the FPS

![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GUSpCUhN/images/166565c6edbebf6b6852eed02344561237f9c9e7_350.webp)

**IceOptimizer** is a lightweight, performance-focused modpack designed to turn your "potato PC" into a smooth gaming machine. Built on the cutting-edge **Fabric** loader, this pack focuses purely on optimization, client-side fixes, and essential quality-of-life features without changing the core vanilla gameplay.

---

### 🚀 Key Optimization Features

* **The Power Trio:** Powered by **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **FerriteCore** to completely overhaul rendering, logic, and memory usage.
* **Smart Culling:** Uses **EntityCulling**, **More Culling**, and **BadOptimizations** to stop rendering things you can't see, saving massive CPU and GPU resources.
* **Seamless Generation:** Integrated with **C2ME** (Concurrent Chunk Management Engine) and **Noisium** to eliminate chunk-loading stutters during exploration.
* **Memory Efficiency:** Thanks to **ModernFix** and **ThreadTweak**, the pack runs beautifully even with only 2GB–4GB of allocated RAM.
* **Network Optimization:** Uses **PacketFixer** to reduce ping and stabilize connections on multiplayer servers.

---

### 🛠 Enhanced Capabilities & QoL

* **OptiFine Features:** Full support for shaders (**Iris Shaders**), zoom (**Zoomify**), and optimized resource pack loading (**Language Reload**, **Animatica**, **EBE**).
* **Bug Fixes:** Eliminates over 100+ vanilla bugs out-of-the-box using **Debugify** and **Not Enough Crashes**.
* **Effortless Multiplayer:** Includes **e4mc**, allowing you to open your singleplayer world to friends without setting up complex port forwarding or hosting servers.

---

### 📥 Quick Installation

1. Go to the **Versions** tab and download the latest `.mrpack` file.
2. Import the file into the **Modrinth App** or **Prism Launcher**.
3. Allocate at least 2GB-4GB of RAM, hit **Play**, and feel the freeze-free experience!

---

### 💬 Support & Feedback
> As this is a newly launched project, your feedback is incredibly valuable! If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or want to share your FPS improvements, please let us know via our issue tracker.
> 
> *If IceOptimizer helped your game run smoother, please consider leaving a **Star (⭐)** to support the project!*
